FightScript: self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance", "2"); if self.Vars ~= nil then self.Vars:set_Item("SunExpMorningShield", "0"); end end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local done = false; if self.Vars ~= nil and self.Vars:ContainsKey("SunExpMorningShield") and self.Vars:get_Item("SunExpMorningShield") == "1" then done = true; end; if done then return end; local rad = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance"); if rad ~= nil then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:ChangeDefence(tostring(5 + rad.buffConfig.Level)); if self.Vars ~= nil then self.Vars:set_Item("SunExpMorningShield", "1"); end; self:UpdateRelicShow(); end end);

self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local burn = self.Self:GetBuff("buff_burn"); if burn == nil or burn.buffConfig.Level <= 0 then return end; burn.buffConfig.Level = burn.buffConfig.Level - 1; if burn.buffConfig.Level <= 0 then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); end; self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame", "2"); end);

self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() SunExp_SetVar(self, "ThisCount", "0"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end); self:AddEvent("Action", function() local count = tonumber(SunExp_GetVar(self, "ThisCount", "0")) or 0; count = count + 1; SunExp_SetVar(self, "ThisCount", count); self:UpdateRelicShow(); if count % 3 ~= 0 then return end; if self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance") ~= nil then SunExp_AddBurnToRandomEnemy(self, "2"); else self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance", "2"); end end);

self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local target = SunExp_GetRandomEnemyTarget(self, true); if target ~= nil then SunExp_TriggerBurn(self, target); SunExp_RemoveBuffStacks(self, target, "buff_burn", "1"); self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame", "2"); else SunExp_AddBurnToRandomEnemy(self, "2"); end; self:UpdateRelicShow(); end);

local function resetPhase() SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpZ4", "0"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpZ8", "0"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpZ12", "0"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; local function checkPhase() local level = SunExp_GetRadianceLevel(self); if level <= 0 then return end; self:SetStatus("Self"); if level >= 4 and SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpZ4", "0") == "0" then self:DrawCount("1"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpZ4", "1"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; if level >= 8 and SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpZ8", "0") == "0" then self:ChangePower("1"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpZ8", "1"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; if level >= 12 and SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpZ12", "0") == "0" then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); SunExp_TriggerBurnAllEnemies(self, 1); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpZ12", "1"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end end; self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() resetPhase(); end); self:AddEvent("Action", function() checkPhase(); end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() checkPhase(); end);

self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local field = self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_scorching_canopy"); if field == nil or field.buffConfig.Level <= 0 then return end; self:SetStatus("Self"); self:ChangeDefence(tostring(field.buffConfig.Level * 3)); local burn = self.Self:GetBuff("buff_burn"); if burn ~= nil and burn.buffConfig.Level > 0 then burn.buffConfig.Level = burn.buffConfig.Level - 1; if burn.buffConfig.Level <= 0 then self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); end; self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame", "1"); else self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance", "1"); end end);

self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_crown", "1"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance", "4"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_scorching_canopy", "2"); end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() if SunExp_IsSelfBurnProtected(self, true) then local targets = SunExp_GetEnemyTargets(self); for i = 1, #targets do SunExp_AddStatusBuff(self, targets[i], "buff_burn", "1"); end end end);

local function resetPrism() SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpPrismDone", "0"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpPrismLastRadiance", SunExp_GetRadianceLevel(self)); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; local function checkPrism() local current = SunExp_GetRadianceLevel(self); local last = tonumber(SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpPrismLastRadiance", tostring(current))) or current; if SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpPrismDone", "0") == "0" and current > last then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("buff_extraordinary", "1"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpPrismDone", "1"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); current = SunExp_GetRadianceLevel(self); end; SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpPrismLastRadiance", current); end; self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_radiance", "1"); resetPrism(); end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() resetPrism(); end); self:AddEvent("Action", function() checkPrism(); end);

local function checkCradle() if SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpCradleDone", "0") == "1" then return end; if self.Self:GetBuff("SunExp_sunexp_solar_crown") == nil then return end; self:SetStatus("Self"); self:DrawCount("1"); self:ChangeDefence("2"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpCradleDone", "1"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpCradleDone", "0"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end); self:AddEvent("Action", function() checkCradle(); end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() checkCradle(); end);

local function resetCharm() SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpMoltenCharmDone", "0"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpMoltenCharmLastBurn", SunExp_GetBuffLevel(self, "buff_burn")); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; local function checkCharm() local current = SunExp_GetBuffLevel(self, "buff_burn"); local last = tonumber(SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpMoltenCharmLastBurn", tostring(current))) or current; if SunExp_GetVar(self, "SunExpMoltenCharmDone", "0") == "0" and current > last then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame", "2"); SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpMoltenCharmDone", "1"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end; SunExp_SetVar(self, "SunExpMoltenCharmLastBurn", current); end; self:AddEvent("FightStart", function() resetCharm(); end); self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() resetCharm(); end); self:AddEvent("Action", function() checkCharm(); end);

self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local burn = self.Self:GetBuff("buff_burn"); if burn == nil or burn.buffConfig.Level < 4 then return end; burn.buffConfig.Level = burn.buffConfig.Level - 2; if burn.buffConfig.Level <= 0 then self:SetStatus("Self"); self:RemoveBuff("buff_burn"); end; self:SetStatus("Self"); self:ChangeDefence("2"); self:AddBuff("SunExp_sunexp_gathered_flame", "2"); self:UpdateRelicShow(); end);

self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local targets = SunExp_GetEnemyTargets(self); if #targets == 0 then return end; for i = 1, #targets do if SunExp_GetStatusBuffLevel(targets[i], "buff_burn") <= 0 then return end end; for i = 1, #targets do SunExp_AddStatusBuff(self, targets[i], "buff_weak", "1"); end; self:UpdateRelicShow(); end);

self:AddEvent("StartRound", function() local targets = SunExp_GetEnemyTargets(self); if #targets < 2 then return end; local burning = {}; for i = 1, #targets do local burn = targets[i]:GetBuff("buff_burn"); if burn ~= nil and burn.buffConfig.Level > 0 then table.insert(burning, targets[i]); end end; if #burning == 0 then return end; local triggerCount = math.min(4, #burning); for n = 1, triggerCount do local source = burning[math.random(1, #burning)]; local choices = {}; for i = 1, #targets do if targets[i].InstanceId ~= source.InstanceId then table.insert(choices, targets[i]); end end; if #choices > 0 then local target = choices[math.random(1, #choices)]; SunExp_AddStatusBuff(self, target, "buff_burn", "1"); end end; self:UpdateRelicShow(); end);
